title: The Bells Rung
subtitle: The week opens, and the village pays on the spot
description: Harvest week opens at the church bell, rung before sunrise because
the village has never once been accused of mercy.
Complete the quest and the reward is already in your pockets: the
chapter's `autoClaim: enabled` pays on completion, with the toast
the village insists on. The reward below also creates the
scoreboard objective the dance card later reads --
`tasked_harvest_favour` -- which is the village's own ledger, made
by a command reward the moment it is paid.
